Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext

Class DocumentContext

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.DocumentContext
public final class DocumentContext extends Object
A loaded document, handed to extensions through TextEditorExtension.onDocumentOpened(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.DocumentContext) and TextEditorExtension.onDocumentSaved(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.DocumentContext).

The text mutator is supplied by the broker: it is the real document mutator for extensions granted TextEditorPermission.WRITE and a silent no-op otherwise, so the permission gate is enforced without the extension having to check it.

  • Constructor Details

    • DocumentContext

      public DocumentContext(String filePath, String fileName, String fullText, String selectedText, Consumer<String> textMutator, Consumer<String> selectionMutator)
      Back-compatible form without caret/selection geometry: the position accessors report zero. New extensions that need the caret (go-to-definition, completion) should be handed a context built through the wider constructor.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the full file path, or null for an unsaved document
      fileName - the file name, or null for an unsaved document
      fullText - the full document text
      selectedText - the currently selected text (empty if nothing selected)
      textMutator - replaces the full document (gated on WRITE)
      selectionMutator - replaces the selection (gated on WRITE)

    • DocumentContext

      public DocumentContext(String filePath, String fileName, String fullText, String selectedText, int caretOffset, int caretLine, int caretColumn, int selectionStart, int selectionEnd, Consumer<String> textMutator, Consumer<String> selectionMutator)
      Parameters:
      filePath - the full file path, or null for an unsaved document
      fileName - the file name, or null for an unsaved document
      fullText - the full document text
      selectedText - the currently selected text (empty if nothing selected)
      caretOffset - the 0-based caret offset into fullText
      caretLine - the 1-based caret line (0 when unknown)
      caretColumn - the 1-based caret column (0 when unknown)
      selectionStart - the 0-based selection start (== caretOffset when empty)
      selectionEnd - the 0-based selection end (== caretOffset when empty)
      textMutator - replaces the full document (gated on WRITE)
      selectionMutator - replaces the selection (gated on WRITE)
